ModMetaData.name: APB: Reloaded Weapon Pack
ModMetaData.author: Stellunia
ModMetaData.description:
A first, for me. An occupational thing for me to do while I procastinate about other things; I aim to add more weapons that are IRL-adjacent from the free to play game APB Reloaded. Don't play it, it's terrible.
Pistols: - FR0G 'Kokoe' - ACT 44
Shotguns: - NFAS-12 'True Ogre' - Shredder EB
SMGs: - Norseman 'Hoenir'
Assault Rifles: - COBR-A 'Venom' - COBR-A 'Adder'
Semi-Automatic Rifles: - To be added
Snipers: - N-HVR 762
LMGs: - ALIG 'Surefire'
Explosive Weapons: - OSMAW - EOL 'Deep Impact'
All textures were made by me in GIMP.
All sounds belong to APB Reloaded and its respective owners, Reloaded Productions and Little Orbit.
